purpose: Curated LunaRunes reading examples across draw formats and media. The historical LOC1 filename is retained as provenance/compatibility only and does not define Current ownership.
governance: Media assets remain authoritative in their governed source Scope; this registry stores only reading-example references and rune provenance.
Do not infer missing runes or orientations. Preserve author-provided rune order and direction exactly when available.
Public/mass-divination examples are kept separate from personal OW3gs validation cases.
For multi-card examples, preserve thematic sequence and record how later cards refine, diagnose, or redirect the first card instead of treating cards as isolated sentences.
Historical LOC1–8 identifiers are provenance only and cannot define Current Scope, Feature ownership or Canon authority.
